Thanks for flagging this, Aneta — really appreciate the photo.

Short answer: follow the conference's local time (CET) — our calendar invite was created from my laptop which was still set to my home timezone (PT) when I sent the batch invites; looks like the invite scaled incorrectly for attendees. Apologies for the scramble.

To resolve quickly, are you ok with 15:30 CET (15:30 +01:00)? That should be 06:30 PT for me but I can be there in person — I'm walking the floor. If 15:30 is tight, I can do 16:00 CET or we can meet at 10:30 CET (the booth monitor time) if that matches the conference schedule.

I'll attach an updated .ics for 15:30 CET so your calendar picks up the right local time (redwood-demo-v1.ics). If we do 15:30, I'll meet you at booth 4B and bring a laptop with the short walkthrough.

Onwards,
Sean

Looping in since I'm on-site too — I can join at 15:30 CET and will bring the API demo focused on Dedicated capacity (2-3 minute deep dive + Q&A).

Heads up: we've seen venue systems flip between "conference time" and "local wall time" at EU events when the venue's AV controller is defaulted to UTC or local DST settings. Valencia should be at CET (UTC+1) now that DST has ended, but some booth displays still show earlier pre-DST times.

Plan B: if the booth monitor and app disagree again, let's meet at Exhibition Meeting Room 3 (right behind Hall B) ten minutes before the scheduled slot and we'll walk over together. That avoids dead air if the wall screen gets resynced at kickoff.

Can someone from KubeCloud ops confirm the final time in the conference app?

Marissa
